dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tell me about your trip, Emma!
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛl miː əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈtrɪp, ˈɛmə!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We went on a day trip to an island.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwɛnt ɑːn ə ˈdeɪ ˌtrɪp tə ən ˈaɪlənd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, we took a speedboat. We saw dolphins!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, wiː ˈtʊk ə ˈspiːdboʊt. wiː ˈsɔː ˈdɑːlfɪnz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? What was the island like?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt wʌz ði ˈaɪlənd ˈlaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Beautiful! We spent five hours there and had lunch on the beach.
dialogue.reading: ˈbjuːtəfəl! wiː ˈspɛnt ˈfaɪv ˈaʊərz ˈðɛr ənd ˈhæd ˈlʌntʃ ɑːn ðə ˈbiːtʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Amazing! I want to go there, too.
dialogue.reading: əˈmeɪzɪŋ! aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You can! Oh, and I bought you a souvenir. Here you are.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈkæn! ˈoʊ, ənd aɪ ˈbɔːt juː ə ˌsuːvəˈnɪr. ˈhɪr juː ˈɑːr.
